title: Highschool Terra Story
native_title: ハイスクール・テラ・ストーリー
overview:
Why not try falling in love?

A pure love story played out with 8 beautiful girls.

Which girl will you fall in love with?

Highschool Terra Story is a dating simulation in which you play a high school student. Attend classes to build up your own abilities, and spend your free time asking girls out on dates to raise their affection for you, all in the hope of finding true love before your school days run out.

- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Rated for ages 18 and over

恋を、してみませんか？

8人の美少女達と繰り広げる純愛物語
あなたはどの女の子と恋におちますか？
